import ctypes,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path(r"C:\ap11-accd-gettext01\projection-moved-b\mingwarm64\bin")
intl=ctypes.CDLL(str(p/'libintl-8.dll')); intl.libintl_setlocale.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_char_p]; intl.libintl_setlocale.restype=ctypes.c_char_p
locale=intl.libintl_setlocale(0,b'')
lib=ctypes.CDLL(str(p/'libtre-5.dll'))
lib.tre_regerror.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_size_t];lib.tre_regerror.restype=ctypes.c_size_t
r=[]
for error in (1,2,3,4,5):
    n=lib.tre_regerror(error,None,None,0)
    if not 1<=n<=4096: raise RuntimeError('Invalid required error-buffer length')
    b=ctypes.create_string_buffer(n); written=lib.tre_regerror(error,None,b,n)
    r.append({'error':error,'required':n,'returned':written,'text':b.value.decode('utf-8'),'nul_terminated':b.raw[-1]==0,'length_matches':written==n})
print(json.dumps({'scope':'actual libtre C error API, not full regex or NLS qualification','locale':repr(locale),'cases':r}))
